top_signals.title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
top_signals.summary: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
